difficulty_note: "difficult" column = Difficult and above (Difficult, Expert, Insane).
cross_check: unboundwiki-style Fandom list (https://pokemonunbound.fandom.com/wiki/Gym_Leader) shows the same Difficult+ caps before gyms: 20,26,32,36,45,52,57,61. Third-party pokemonunboundpokedex.com lists different caps (20,26,32,36,45,52,58,64) and is NOT used.
extra: No extra cap steps exist beyond the Tarmigan Mansion step; caps vanish once you are Champion.
